common_port_obligations.nearest: Surface current is query; machine current is candidate (Left), queries is Right. Do not exchange the four mixed Carrier combinations.
common_port_obligations.mean_graphs: Sample(index) occurrences preserve repeat/order. Reachability traversal may deduplicate edges, semantic samples may not.
common_port_obligations.merge_rankings: Current first then each peer is Sample(index); repeated peers and zero weights retain validation.
common_port_obligations.reach/traverse: Primary Graph plus Right selector when present. Do not count a field/ID string as a producer.
common_port_obligations.bindings: Nearest lexical identity resolves before type selection; no outer fallback.

a0_remaining: inspect exact closed signatures for rows explicitly marked

seed_completeness: match_nodes and match_edges already exist in the reviewed seed; preserve their current profiles without treating them as new additions.
